My Story

Real estate, the human way.

I help buyers and sellers across the Gulf Coast make confident moves — because a home is more than a transaction, it's the foundation of the legacy you're building. Every client gets my full attention, straight answers, and a strategy built around their goals.

I know these neighborhoods inside and out: where the value is, what buyers are really looking for, and how to position a home to sell. My promise is simple — sharp strategy, honest guidance, and no pressure, ever.

— Amanda

As Seen On TV

Host of The American Dream

I'm the local host of The American Dream TV — an award-winning show celebrating the people, places, and lifestyle of our Gulf Coast communities, streaming on Prime Video, Apple TV, Roku, Tubi, Fire TV, CNBC, and Bloomberg Television.

For my sellers, that's a powerful edge: I can feature your home and neighborhood to an audience far beyond the usual listing sites.

  • Cinematic, broadcast-quality home features
  • Exposure across major streaming platforms
  • Marketing most agents simply can't offer
